schema.text: When you cycle, how often do you arrive in the time you planned?

ar.#When you cycle, how often do you arrive: عند ركوب الدراجة، كم مرة تصل في الوقت الذي خططت له؟

de.#When you cycle, how often do you arrive: Wie oft kommen Sie mit dem Rad in der Zeit an, die Sie eingeplant haben?

en.#When you cycle, how often do you arrive: When you cycle, how often do you arrive in the time you planned?

fa.#When you cycle, how often do you arrive: هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری، چقدر پیش می‌آید که در زمانی که برنامه‌ریزی کرده‌اید به مقصد برسید؟

fr.#When you cycle, how often do you arrive: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, à quelle fréquence arrivez-vous dans le temps que vous aviez prévu ?

hu.#When you cycle, how often do you arrive: Kerékpározás közben milyen gyakran ér célba a tervezett idő alatt?

it.#When you cycle, how often do you arrive: Quando vai in bici, quanto spesso arrivi nel tempo che avevi previsto?

tr.#When you cycle, how often do you arrive: Bisiklet sürerken gideceğiniz yere ne sıklıkla planladığınız sürede ulaşıyorsunuz?
